$comment: WO036-1: promote 6 retargeted rows (cls dialog) — react-port contract specs for dialog-level entries. These 6 cls-dialog tokens (dialogdepth-fr.grammar-ai-propose-cancel, insert.smartart, insert.text-from-file, image.photo-editor, dialogdepth.textfromfile-cancel, dialogdepth.field-cancel) were override-only with legacy dialog-action assertions. In the React canvas editor: buttons dispatch wo-command events or open right-side panels; the legacy dialog DOM does not exist. Promotion replaces the legacy assertion with a React contract (dom-mutation/op-emitted), making these rows non-retarget.

contract.note: loop36-1 react-port: ai-tab Grammar & Spelling button (#btn-ai-grammar-spelling, command: aiGrammarSpelling) opens the ai-assistant right panel [data-wo-right-panel="ai-assistant"] in the react canvas editor. Legacy dialog-action used #ai-propose-dialog/#btn-ai-propose-cancel DOM.

dialogdepth-fr.grammar-ai-propose-cancel.note: depth (ledger review.grammar-spelling): AI grammar dialog depth. Legacy: #ai-propose-dialog is closed by #btn-ai-propose-cancel.

contract.note: loop36-1 react-port: insert-tab SmartArt button (#btn-insert-smart-art, command: insertSmartArt) opens the shape right panel [data-wo-right-panel="shape"] (the graphic-object surface in the react canvas editor). Legacy dialog-action used #smartart-dialog/#btn-smartart-ok DOM.

loop36-1 react-port: insert-tab Text from File button (#btn-text-from-file, command: textFromFile) dispatches wo-command event (word-commands.ts creates hidden file input). Legacy dialog-action used #textfromfile-dialog/#btn-textfromfile-cancel DOM.

loop36-1 react-port: plugins-tab Photo Editor button (#btn-photo-editor, command: photoEditor) opens the plugins right panel [data-wo-right-panel="plugins"] (photoEditor is a plugin in the react canvas editor). Legacy dialog-action used #photo-editor-dialog/#btn-photo-editor-apply DOM with file fixture.

image.photo-editor.note: photoEditorApply needs photoEditorImage loaded — assertion.files feeds #photo-editor-file, apply crops/filters onto canvas and closes

contract.note: loop36-1 react-port: insert-tab Text from File button (#btn-text-from-file, command: textFromFile) dispatches wo-command event. Legacy dialog-action used #textfromfile-dialog/#btn-textfromfile-cancel DOM. Same surface as loop35-3 dialogdepth-fr.textfromfile-cancel.

dialogdepth.textfromfile-cancel.note: depth: ledger row dialog.textfromfile-dialog.l4 — #textfromfile-dialog is closed by its Cancel button #btn-textfromfile-cancel

contract.note: loop36-1 react-port: layout-tab Field button (#btn-insert-field, command: insertField) dispatches wo-command event (word-commands.ts:445 inserts field span or calls onRichTextCommand). Legacy dialog-action used #field-dialog/#btn-field-cancel DOM.

dialogdepth.field-cancel.note: depth: ledger row dialog.field-dialog.l4 — #field-dialog is closed by its Cancel button #btn-field-cancel
